NONE: › the high crying sound of a cat

C: › an unpleasant fog that smells bad
› a very unpleasant general feeling or character of a situation or place

example: A miasma of pollution hung in the air above Mexico City.
污染物形成的毒霧瀰漫在墨西哥城的上空。
After he lost his job, he sank into a miasma of poverty and despair.
失業後，他漸漸墜入貧困與絕望中。
